name: control-channel-active-real-capture
for: The real active-state half of #65: a freshly created session whose control channel is genuinely connected, captured through this service's own create path (colab-fleet #70) rather than waited for. Pins three things the constructed fixture in control-channel-failed-reads-healthy could not: that a live capture of the active label actually classifies as active once the matcher's anchor can see it (#75 — before that fix this case's own replay failed with the channel reported absent, not active); that the label survives redaction even though it shares the model/plan row with the project name (▸ Opus 5 · <project> /rc) rather than the row the constructed fixture assumed, the arrangement #73 and #74 exist to keep intact; and — since #76 landed — that the control-channel state survives the ordinary no-spinner-empty-composer ambiguity (#13/#8) this screen also happens to be an instance of, resolving to idle only after the second look. Before #76 this second observation could not assert wantControlChannel at all: landing this case is what found that the promotion to idle silently dropped the field. Now that #76 fixes the promotion to carry the candidate state forward rather than rebuilding it, both observations pin the channel, which is exactly the regression #76's own commit needs a standing case to guard.
source: #65 (capture), #70 (the create-path method), #73, #74 and #75 (the redaction and matcher bugs this capture exposed and that were fixed before it could land honestly), #76 (found while landing this case, fixed after)
redactedFrom: real capture, redacted by corpus-redact from a session created for this purpose and closed immediately after capture
